description: Abstract class implementing core logic for processing loan repayment schedules, handling transactions such as payments, refunds, charge-offs, chargebacks, and related adjustments within a loan management system.

classes.name: AbstractLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing core logic for processing loan repayment transactions, including handling payments, refunds, charge-offs, chargebacks, and adjustments, designed to be extended for specific repayment strategies.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Checks if the processor accepts a given code or name.

methods.name: reprocessLoanTransactions
methods.description: Reprocesses a list of loan transactions over a repayment schedule, handling charges, overpayments, and transaction adjustments.

methods.name: processLatestTransaction
methods.description: Processes the latest loan transaction, handling different transaction types such as write-offs, refunds, chargebacks, and overpayments.

methods.name: handleRepaymentSchedule
methods.description: Processes a schedule of loan transactions and returns unprocessed amount.

methods.name: isInterestFirstRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Indicates if this processor handles interest-first repayment schedules; returns false by default.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method for handling early/advance payments.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method for handling on-time payments.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method for handling late payments.

methods.name: onLoanOverpayment
methods.description: Hook invoked when a transaction results in an overpayment.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method for handling refunds of installments.

methods.name: isTransactionInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is an advance payment relative to an installment due date.

methods.name: isTransactionALateRepaymentOnInstallment
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is late relative to an installment due date.

methods.name: recalculateChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Recalculates and processes a charge-off transaction, adjusting principal, interest, and charges.

methods.name: reprocessChargebackTransactionRelation
methods.description: Reprocesses transaction relations for chargebacks.

methods.name: reprocessInstallments
methods.description: Re-evaluates and updates installment obligations based on transactions and waivers.

methods.name: isTransactionAfterObligationsMetOnDate
methods.description: Checks if obligations were met before a given waiver transaction date.

methods.name: isObligationsMetOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Checks if obligations are met on disbursement date.

methods.name: isNotObligationsMet
methods.description: Checks if obligations are not met for an installment.

methods.name: recalculateCreditTransaction
methods.description: Recalculates a credit transaction, adjusting overpayments and related components.

methods.name: getMergedTransactionList
methods.description: Merges original and changed transactions into a single list.

methods.name: createNewTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record, reversing the original and linking relations.

methods.name: processCreditTransaction
methods.description: Processes a credit transaction, adjusting principal, overpayments, and schedule mappings.

methods.name: handleTransactionAndCharges
methods.description: Handles transaction processing along with associated charges, updating outstanding amounts.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Processes individual installments for a transaction, handling advance, late, or on-time payments.

methods.name: extractFeeCharges
methods.description: Filters fee charges from a set of charges.

methods.name: extractPenaltyCharges
methods.description: Filters penalty charges from a set of charges.

methods.name: updateChargesPaidAmountBy
methods.description: Updates the paid amount for charges, distributing payments across charges.

methods.name: findEarliestUnpaidChargeFromUnOrderedSet
methods.description: Finds the earliest unpaid charge from a set.

methods.name: handleWriteOff
methods.description: Handles write-off transactions, adjusting outstanding principal, interest, and charges.

methods.name: handleChargeback
methods.description: Handles chargeback transactions, adjusting related payments.

methods.name: handleChargeOff
methods.description: Handles charge-off transactions, recalculating outstanding amounts.

methods.name: handleCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Handles credit balance refunds.

methods.name: handleRefund
methods.description: Handles refund transactions, adjusting installments and charges.

methods.name: undoChargesPaidAmountBy
methods.description: Reverses or partially reverses charges paid amounts.

methods.name: findLatestPaidChargeFromUnOrderedSet
methods.description: Finds the latest paid or partially paid charge.

methods.name: addChargeOnlyRepaymentInstallmentIfRequired
methods.description: Adds a charge-only repayment installment if needed.

methods.name: getLatestLoanChargeWithSpecificDueDate
methods.description: Retrieves the latest loan charge with a specific due date.

methods.name: getInterestTillChargeOffForPeriod
methods.description: Calculates interest accrued till charge-off date for a loan period.

methods.name: createMissingAccrualTransactionDuringChargeOffIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates accrual transactions if missing during charge-off processing.
